import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd()
def w(n,s):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
p=Path('ACTUALBRIEF.md');s=p.read_text().replace('Remaining15 original bodies unread','Remaining14 assigned original bodies unread');w(p.name,s)
prov=json.loads(Path('provenance.json').read_text());assert len(prov)==20
for p in prov:
 raw=Path('originals/'+str(p['id'])+'.jsonl').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==p['raw_sha256'];assert raw.endswith(b'\n')
 token=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',raw).group(1);assert hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest()==p['token_sha256'];assert hashlib.sha256(json.loads(token).encode()).hexdigest()==p['statement_sha256']
charges=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];budget=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert budget['calls_used']==len(charges)==2;assert budget['queries_used']==6
ledger=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];prev='0'*64
for raw in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 o=json.loads(raw);assert o['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
print('HTTP events',[(r['event'],r.get('url')) for r in ledger]);print('OWN FILES',[p.name for p in lane.iterdir()]);print('TASK LENGTH',len(Path('TASK.txt').read_text()));print('TASK RECOVERY',Path('TASK.txt').read_text()[17000:27000])
w('inventories.json',json.dumps({'originals':{'count':20,'raw_token_decoded_bindings_verified':True,'ids':sorted(p['id'] for p in prov)},'HTTP':{'attempts':sum(r['event']=='attempt' for r in ledger),'successes':sum(r['event']=='success' for r in ledger),'unavailable':sum(r['event']=='unavailable' for r in ledger),'ledger_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'search':budget,'figures':{'visually_inspected':[],'material_uninspected':['1008.1837 Figure20','1006.2560 path figures','1101.0517 Figures1/2'],'limit':'No original novel certificate relies on an uninspected figure'},'history_access_count':len(json.loads(Path('history-access.json').read_text())),'resources':'Every completed runner invocation has its actual receipt/output; native tool CPU/RSS and writer peaks unavailable; no universal cgroup assertion','provenance_recovery':'Initial id-key zero-match receipt retained; mathdb_id recovery preserves fixed20'},indent=2))
